# Car Buying Negotiation Skill for Muse

Negotiating a car purchase without getting played: the out-the-door-price method (never negotiate the monthly payment), dealer tactics and their countermeasures — the four-square worksheet, "let me check with my manager," manufactured urgency — separating price, trade-in, and financing into three deals, add-ons to refuse, and a concrete walk-out plan. Genuinely concrete and actionable, not dealership mystique. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: clearly US-centric (dealerships, $ prices, miles) — good judgment by the skill itself, which reminds you to verify current prices and rates rather than trusting its numbers blindly.
